Shrouded in mystery, little is known about who '''"Spike"''' really is. Mainly the creator and developer of [[FTE]], his fingers are also into many QW related projects. With deep knowledge of Quake code, combined with a long history of developing it, he is by many perceived as omnipotent in the field.
